newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 4.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

* The Dow Jones industrial average fell 7.45 points to 6,021.93. For the week, it was up 14.91 points. Stock and bond prices edged lower Friday as investors chose to mark time ahead of Tuesday's presidential and congressional elections.
* The Pacific Asia Travel Association sees Indonesia becoming the most robust tourist destination in the region, with an average annual growth of 12.6 percent until the year 2000.
* The Jakarta Composite Index rose 2.63 points, or 0.46 percent, to close at 570.66 points on Friday.
* On Monday morning, the Indonesian rupiah was quoted at 2,329.0/30.0 at 0150 GMT.
* Shipping firm Berlian Laju Tanker on newsreport saying that the company sees 35 percent profit growth for 1997 and 38 percent average profit growth for the next three consecutive years.
* Property firm PT Mas Murni Indonesia on a report saying one Singaporean investor had bought 10 million shares in the company on Friday.
* Chemical company PT Unggul Indah Corporation on the company's announcement that it planned to acquire PT Wiranusa Grahatama through its subsidiary.

* Telecommunication firm PT Telkom on announcement that the company will give incentive shares to Indonesian shareholders who have held stock since November 2, 1995 and commit to not selling their holdings before November 14, 1996.
